summary: Per-frame yaw-recovery state machine for a vehicle. Branches on the postProcessInput state dword at obj+0x4064: the non-zero path accumulates time at this+0x4004 and, past a 15.0 threshold, clears accumulator counters and (when session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 and the audio flag at this+0x1051 is set) fires an audio effect. The zero-state path checks an off-track guard (obj+0x4170 below FLT_MAX, global dword_7CE814, a 4-slot entity array at this+0x828, and this+0x3994) and, when the vehicle is far from the track, resets counters and triggers a position recovery: nearest-path lookup via sub_403640, a lateral-distance test against the path bounds, and when out of bounds emits RenderCallWithGuard + AIVehiclePathPositionTracking + StateChangeNotify (session 7) and marks this+0x3D60 = 2.

local_names.v15: nearest path data returned by sub_403640

operations.description: Per-frame tick invoked from VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController (frame-path enabled).
Dereference this[0] to obtain the obj base pointer.
Read accumulated-time float at this+0x4004 into a local, then clear the field.
Read state dword at obj+0x4064; selects between the non-zero processing path and the zero-state recovery-check path.
On the non-zero path, require this+0x32BC == 1 (qualifying-type flag) and state != 2 before the simple accumulation branch.
Accumulate frame delta a2 into the stored value at this+0x4004.
If the accumulator exceeds 15.0, reset this+0x4004 and clear counters this+0x3D48, this+0x3D4C, this+0x3D50.
When session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 and the audio-trigger byte at this+0x1051 is set, run the audio effect path.
AudioSoundEffectController(this + 0x6E4, value of this+0x1048); clears the audio flag at this+0x1051.
Copy the source position triple this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC into the output triple this+0x3FF8/0x3FFC/0x4000.
Zero-state path: when the unshown comparison flags v8|v9 are clear, copy the position triple and return.
With this+0x32BC set, return early when the float at obj+0x4170 is below FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38).
With this+0x32BC clear, return early when global dword_7CE814 is non-zero.
Scan the 4-slot entity array starting at this+0x828 (74-dword stride), checking each slot pointer and the flag byte at this+0x868.
If all 4 slots are occupied and fabs of the float at this+0x3994 exceeds 0.1, return early.
sub_4D21D0 gates the off-track recovery check.
Require obj+0x3450 != 3 and DistanceComparison to report the vehicle as off-track before recovery can trigger.
Accumulate a2 into this+0x4004; if the result exceeds the threshold flt_7D0A8C, enter the recovery reset block.
Reset counters at this+0x3D48, this+0x3D4C, this+0x3D50.
sub_403640(dword_5EA2C0, position pointer this+0x34D4, 0) looks up the nearest path data; result stored at this+0x3A9C.
Dot product of the position offset (this+0x34D8, this+0x34DC) against the path direction (v15[8..10]); selects lateral distance from v15[11]/v15[12] and path bounds from v15[22]/v15[23] by sign.
sub_41B250 on the obj pointer.
If lateral distance is below 7.0 or the path bound test fails, mark recovery state at this+0x3D60 = 2.
When session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, additionally emit render and AI-tracking notifications.
RenderCallWithGuard(*this, v29, v28), AIVehiclePathPositionTracking(this, v29, v28), and StateChangeNotify(this + 0x32C0, 0).
When this+0x32BC is clear, set global dword_7CE258 = 1.
